title: fix(service-automation): a stored connector under a host plugin connector's name is skipped at start, as it is while the platform runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4gSF1mHqRhZEva62pbKFEW)_

Fixes #28713

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/core` adds one read-only public member, `dispatchesBootPhaseHooks()`, on `ObjectKernel` and `ObjectKernelBase` (so `LiteKernel`); no accepted value changes, nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:环境里保存的连接器(元数据门 / Studio 保存)若与宿主插件提供的连接器同名,平台启动时的处理与运行中完全一致:插件的连接器照常服务,保存的那条不服务并记录日志。保存的连接器改为在所有插件启动完成后再实例化(仍在服务器开始接收请求之前)。另在 `@objectstack/core` 的两种内核上加一个只读方法 `dispatchesBootPhaseHooks()`,让插件在自己的 `start()` 里知道启动阶段钩子是否会派发;不会派发(或宿主不回答)时,保存的连接器仍在自动化插件的 `start()` 中实例化,与原来一样,绝不落空。
- 为什么改:运行中已经判定"插件优先、保存条目跳过",启动时却在插件注册前就下了"名字空闲"的结论,两处判定不一致。这是可用性问题,不是数据问题;细节在席位处。
- 风险与回滚:优先级不变(插件仍优先,未改 ADR-0097 §4),宿主自己声明的连接器与已安装包的连接器启动行为不变,有对照测试钉住。core 只新增一个只读方法。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`(`holdStoredEntries`、`kernelDispatchesBootPhaseHooks`、`kernel:bootstrapped` 那一轮的 `held` 判断)、`packages/core/src/kernel.ts` 与 `kernel-base.ts` 的新方法、`src/connector-materialization.test.ts` 新的 #28713 一节。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-materialization.test.ts`,预期 108/108 通过(含 #28713 一节 6 例:插件同名跳过、空闲名在监听前就绪、宿主同名仍失败、三种不派发钩子的宿主仍在 start 中实例化)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(core 新增公开成员,席位先跑契约复核)。

## What changes

- **A saved connector under a host plugin connector's name: the start agrees with the running platform.** While the platform runs, a provider-bound connector saved in the environment (through the metadata door or Studio) under the name of a connector a host plugin provides is not served beside the plugin's connector: the plugin's connector keeps the name, and the conflict is logged. The start now reaches the same verdict: the plugin's connector is served `ready` under that name, and the saved connector is skipped with the same log record naming it. Precedence is unchanged (the plugin's connector wins, as ADR-0097 §4 already has it on a running platform), so no §4 ruling is needed.
- **When saved connectors materialize.** Connectors saved in the environment are now materialized once every plugin has started (the automation service's existing `kernel:bootstrapped` connector pass), instead of during the automation plugin's own start. They are still `ready` before the server accepts requests. Connectors the host's own stack declares, and an installed package's, still materialize during the automation plugin's start, with their fail-loud behavior unchanged, including on a name a plugin's connector also uses.
- **A saved connector is never left unserved.** The deferral applies only on a kernel that says it dispatches its boot-phase hooks. `@objectstack/core` gains `dispatchesBootPhaseHooks()`, read-only: `ObjectKernel` answers `false` exactly when its `bootPhaseHooks` option is `false`; `LiteKernel` (and anything on `ObjectKernelBase`) answers `true`. On a kernel that answers `false`, or a host whose kernel does not expose the member, saved connectors materialize during the automation plugin's start, as before.
- No save-door change: a connector under such a name is still accepted at save. Rows already at rest are covered by this change; a save-door refusal would be a separate narrowing.

## Tests

- **Unit, `connector-materialization.test.ts`, new `#28713` describe (6 cases):** a saved entry under a name a plugin registers in its own `start()` (after the automation plugin's): the boot starts, the plugin's connector serves its own action, the saved entry is skipped with the §4 record; control: a saved entry under a free name is not yet registered when a later plugin starts and is registered by `kernel:listening`; control: the host's own entry under such a name still fails the boot; a real `ObjectKernel` with `bootPhaseHooks: false`, and a host whose kernel has no reader or answers `false`, keep saved entries in the start reconcile so they serve.
- **Kernel pins:** `kernel.boot-phase-hooks.test.ts` reads `dispatchesBootPhaseHooks()` from a plugin's own `start()`: `false` under `bootPhaseHooks: false`, `true` for absent / `true` / `undefined`; `lite-kernel.test.ts` pins `true`.
- **Restart dogfood, `stored-connector-package-ref-restart.dogfood.test.ts`:** the first start also saves an environment-wide connector under the showcase's `slack` plugin connector name; the second start over the same database starts, lists the plugin's `slack` connector `ready` with the plugin's actions (not the saved one's), and its start record names the saved entry; control: the saved inline connector is already `ready` on the first read after the start.

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head, ablations</summary>

- Red: production sources (`plugin.ts`, `kernel.ts`, `kernel-base.ts`) restored to base `1c5b1773`, rebuilt: unit `2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (the two new #28713 cases that measure behavior; the hookless-host cases pass on base, as base keeps every saved entry in the start reconcile); restart dogfood `8 failed | 1 passed (9)`. Tree restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Green on head: unit `108 passed (108)`; dogfood `stored-connector-package-ref-restart`, `stored-connector-package-ref`, `install-local-restart-connectors`: `3 passed (3)` files, `21 passed (21)` tests.
- Ablation 1 (saved entries back into the start reconcile: the hold set to a constant false): marker present in both built files of `@objectstack/service-automation`; unit `2 failed | 106 passed`, restart dogfood `8 failed | 1 passed`. Restored: blob `9f3bdcad` == HEAD, marker absent after rebuild, tree clean.
- Ablation 2 (the kernel reader forced to answer "dispatches"): unit `3 failed | 105 passed` (the three hookless-host cases). Restored: blob `9f3bdcad` == HEAD, marker absent after rebuild, tree clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and type checks</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core --filter @objectstack/service-automation run typecheck`: exit 0 (both `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`: `129 passed` files, `2892 passed` tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: `251 passed` files, `3216 passed` tests.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured, not observed (residue).** Saved connectors now become available a little later during the start (on the showcase, about a third of a second later), still before the server accepts requests. A showcase restart with an instrumented connector registry saw no connector call, effect read or pull before that point. Possible in principle and not observed: an automation that runs during the start itself (a record change made by the app's own start-up work, or a scheduled job whose first run falls inside the start) and calls a saved connector would find it not yet available.
- A kernel that withholds its boot-phase hooks, or a host whose kernel does not say, keeps today's behavior for saved connectors: they are materialized during the automation plugin's start, so they are never left unserved; the conflict this card fixes is not fixed on such a host.
- No save-door refusal for such a name (a narrowing, and it would not cover rows already at rest); it is with the seat as a possible follow-up.

## Verification

Every local reading above is on head `525f355c`. Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): 67 derived, 66 run with exit 0, 1 not measured (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3: its prerequisite, every package's `dist/`, is not met in this checkout). The changeset, ADR-0087, empty-changeset and closing-keyword gates were also run against this body: exit 0. The repo-wide lint, `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's. Overlap: open PR #28693 also edits `service-automation/src/plugin.ts`; `git merge-tree` of its head with this one is clean.
